title: Module 4: Motivation, Engagement & The ARCS Model
description: Understanding how to generate intrinsic and extrinsic motivation in adult learners using Keller's ARCS model and Game-Based Learning mechanics.
learning_objectives: Use the ARCS model to diagnose attention, relevance, confidence, and satisfaction gaps.
Distinguish motivation from surface-level activity or entertainment.
Design engagement moves that strengthen persistence without overwhelming learners.
